description: Retrieve aggregated extraction statistics for the authenticated user. Returns metrics such as total jobs, success and failure counts, and usage breakdowns over the specified date range: at most 366 days, counted back from the end date (an older start date is moved up; an end date after now is moved back to now). Defaults to the last 30 days when no dates are provided. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.
name: statistics
title: Get extraction statistics
